propertySets.name: Pset_Condition
propertySets.definition: Determines the state or condition of an element at a particular point in time.

properties.name: AssessmentDate
properties.definition: Date on which the overall condition is assessed

properties.name: AssessmentCondition
properties.definition: The overall condition of a product based on an assessment of the contributions to the overall condition made by the various criteria considered. The meanings given to the values of assessed condition should be agreed and documented by local agreements. For instance, is overall condition measured on a scale of 1 - 10 or by assigning names such as Good, OK, Poor.

properties.name: AssessmentDescription
properties.definition: Qualitative description of the condition.

properties.name: AssessmentType
properties.definition: Category of latest condition assessment report of the asset.

properties.name: AssessmentMethod
properties.definition: External reference to assessment method or application used to perform the assessment.

properties.name: LastAssessmentReport
properties.definition: Reference to latest condition (state of health) report.

properties.name: NextAssessmentDate
properties.definition: Date of next condition inspection

properties.name: AssessmentFrequency
properties.definition: Indicates how often the equipment should be assessed, to have a clear estimation on its working state, based on which the maintenance staff can decide whether it requires maintenance or requires to be updated or replaced.

propertySets.name: Pset_ConstructionAdministration
propertySets.definition: Properties for Construction Administration. Often used for facility and asset management.

properties.name: ProcurementMethod
properties.definition: The method by which an IfcProductType/IfcProduct is acquired and installed. The value provided shall be one of the following four character acronyms: “CFCI” (meaning Contractor Furnished Contractor Installed), “OFCI” (meaning Owner Furnished Contractor Installed), or “OFOI” (meaning Owner Furnished Owner Installed).

properties.name: SpecificationSectionNumber
properties.definition: A reference number to an external contract technical specification section describing either (a) minimum performance requirements of a given IfcProductType/IfcProduct or (b) a preselection for a specific IfcProductType/IfcProduct made for this project.

properties.name: SubmittalIdentifer
properties.definition: The reference number to an external construction administration submittal used by the construction contractor and/or subcontractor to verify that the referenced IfcProductType/IfcProduct selection conforms with the requirements found in the referenced SpecificationSectionNumber.

properties.name: InstallationDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: ModelNumber
properties.definition: The model number and/or unit designator assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: TagNumber
properties.definition: Tag number.

properties.name: AssetIdentifier
properties.definition: A unique identification assigned to an asset that enables its differentiation from other assets.NOTE  The asset identifier is unique within the asset register. It differs from the globally unique id assigned to the instance of an entity populating a database.

propertySets.name: Pset_ElementKinematics
propertySets.definition: Information confirming that the element has cyclic and/or pathed kinematic behaviour. The resulting envelope may be available as a 'clearance' shape representation.

properties.name: CyclicPath
properties.definition: Represents the time:angle table of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: CyclicRange
properties.definition: Identifies the angular range of the kinematic behaviour

properties.name: LinearPath
properties.definition: Represents the time:distance table of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: LinearRange
properties.definition: Identifies the linear range of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: MaximumAngularVelocity
properties.definition: Identifies the maximum angular velocity of the kinematic behaviour.

properties.name: MaximumConstantSpeed
properties.definition: Identifies the maximum constant speed over the kinematic path.

properties.name: MinimumTime
properties.definition: Identifies the minimum time for the kinematic behaviour.

propertySets.name: Pset_EnvironmentalCondition
propertySets.definition: Properties defining environment conditions required by the element.

properties.name: ReferenceAirRelativeHumidity
properties.definition: Measurement of the ratio of water vapor in the air.

properties.name: ReferenceEnvironmentTemperature
properties.definition: Ideal temperature range.

properties.name: MaximumAtmosphericPressure
properties.definition: Maximum level of atmospheric pressure that the equipment can operate effectively in.

properties.name: StorageTemperatureRange
properties.definition: Allowed storage temperature range that the element complies with.

properties.name: MaximumWindSpeed
properties.definition: Maximum resistance to wind load exposure.

properties.name: OperationalTemperatureRange
properties.definition:
The temperature range in which the device operates normally.

Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

properties.name: MaximumRainIntensity
properties.definition: Maximum level of rain intensity that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is usually measured in millimeter per hour (mm/h).

properties.name: SaltMistLevel
properties.definition: Maximum level of salt mist that the equipment can operate effectively in. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

properties.name: SeismicResistance
properties.definition: Maximum magnitude of earthquake that the equipment complies with. The value indicates earthquake intensity measured in Richter scale.

properties.name: SmokeLevel
properties.definition: Maximum level of smoke that the equipment complies with. It is provided according to an international or national standard.

properties.name: MaximumSolarRadiation
properties.definition: Maximum level of solar irradiance that the equipment can operate effectively in. This is usually tested and measured by a national or international standard. The value indicates power density measured in watt per square meter (w/m2).

propertySets.name: Pset_EnvironmentalImpactIndicators
propertySets.definition:
Environmental impact indicators are related to a given “functional unit” (ISO 14040 concept). An example of functional unit is a "Double glazing window with PVC frame" and the unit to consider is "one square meter of opening elements filled by this product”.
Indicators values are valid for the whole life cycle or only a specific phase (see LifeCyclePhase property). Values of all the indicators are expressed per year according to the expected service life. The first five properties capture the characteristics of the functional unit. The following properties are related to environmental indicators.
There is a consensus agreement international for the five one. Last ones are not yet fully and formally agreed at the international level.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: FunctionalUnitReference
properties.definition: Reference to a database or a classification

properties.name: IndicatorsUnit
properties.definition: The unit of the quantity the environmental indicators values are related with.

properties.name: LifeCyclePhase
properties.definition: The whole life cycle or only a given phase  from which environmental data are valid.

properties.name: ExpectedServiceLife
properties.definition: Expected service life in years.

properties.name: TotalPrimaryEnergyConsumptionPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007.

properties.name: WaterConsumptionPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of water used.

properties.name: HazardousWastePerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of hazardous waste generated

properties.name: NonHazardousWastePerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of non hazardous waste generated

properties.name: ClimateChangePerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of greenhouse gases emitted calculated in equivalent CO2

properties.name: AtmosphericAcidificationPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of gases responsible for the atmospheric acidification calculated in equivalent SO2

properties.name: RenewableEnergyConsumptionPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: NonRenewableEnergyConsumptionPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of non-renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: ResourceDepletionPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of resources used calculated in equivalent antimony

properties.name: InertWastePerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of inert waste generated

properties.name: RadioactiveWastePerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of radioactive waste generated

properties.name: StratosphericOzoneLayerDestructionPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of gases destroying the stratospheric ozone layer calculated in equivalent CFC-R11

properties.name: PhotochemicalOzoneFormationPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of gases creating the photochemical ozone calculated in equivalent ethylene

properties.name: EutrophicationPerUnit
properties.definition: Quantity of eutrophicating compounds calculated in equivalent PO4

propertySets.name: Pset_EnvironmentalImpactValues
propertySets.definition:
The following properties capture environmental impact values of an element. They correspond to the indicators defined into Pset_EnvironmentalImpactIndicators.
Environmental impact values are obtained multiplying indicator value per unit by the relevant quantity of the element.

properties.name: TotalPrimaryEnergyConsumption
properties.definition: Quantity of energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007.

properties.name: WaterConsumption
properties.definition: Quantity of water used.

properties.name: HazardousWaste
properties.definition: Quantity of hazardous waste generated.

properties.name: NonHazardousWaste
properties.definition: Quantity of non hazardous waste generated.

properties.name: ClimateChange
properties.definition: Quantity of greenhouse gases emitted calculated in equivalent CO2.

properties.name: AtmosphericAcidification
properties.definition: Quantity of gases responsible for the atmospheric acidification calculated in equivalent SO2.

properties.name: RenewableEnergyConsumption
properties.definition: Quantity of renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: NonRenewableEnergyConsumption
properties.definition: Quantity of non-renewable energy used as defined in ISO21930:2007

properties.name: ResourceDepletion
properties.definition: Quantity of resources used calculated in equivalent antimony.

properties.name: InertWaste
properties.definition: Quantity of inert waste generated .

properties.name: RadioactiveWaste
properties.definition: Quantity of radioactive waste generated.

properties.name: StratosphericOzoneLayerDestruction
properties.definition: Quantity of gases destroying the stratospheric ozone layer calculated in equivalent CFC-R11.

properties.name: PhotochemicalOzoneFormation
properties.definition: Quantity of gases creating the photochemical ozone calculated in equivalent ethylene.

properties.name: Eutrophication
properties.definition: Quantity of eutrophicating compounds calculated in equivalent PO4.

properties.name: LeadInTime
properties.definition: Lead in time before start of process.

properties.name: Duration
properties.definition:
Duration.

Duration of process.

properties.name: LeadOutTime
properties.definition: Lead out time after end of process.

propertySets.name: Pset_InstallationOccurrence
propertySets.definition: Properties defining installation information for occurrences of element, asset or system.

properties.name: InstallationDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element is installed.

properties.name: AcceptanceDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element is accepted by the manager or administrator.

properties.name: PutIntoOperationDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element is put into operation.

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceStrategy
propertySets.definition: Property set for the association of a maintenance strategy to an element, asset of system.

properties.name: AssetCriticality
properties.definition: Rating of the asset's criticality to the operation of the facility

properties.name: AssetFrailty
properties.definition: Rating of the asset's frailty to breakage or deterioration

properties.name: AssetPriority
properties.definition: Combined criticality and frailty rating indicating the operational and maintenance priority of the asset

properties.name: MonitoringType
properties.definition: Monitoring strategy chosen for the asset

properties.name: AccidentResponse
properties.definition: Accident response chosen for the asset

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceTriggerCondition
propertySets.definition: Trigger levels for an asset that has an inspection-based maintenance strategy

properties.name: ConditionTargetPerformance
properties.definition: Target condition of the asset

properties.name: ConditionMaintenanceLevel
properties.definition: Condition that will trigger maintenance

properties.name: ConditionReplacementLevel
properties.definition: Condition that will trigger a replacement process

properties.name: ConditionDisposalLevel
properties.definition: Condition that will trigger a disposal process

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceTriggerDuration
propertySets.definition: Trigger levels for an asset that has an PPM based maintenance strategy.

properties.name: DurationTargetPerformance
properties.definition: Target time to failure of the asset

properties.name: DurationMaintenanceLevel
properties.definition: Duration interval at which maintenance is performed

properties.name: DurationReplacementLevel
properties.definition: Duration interval at which replacement is performed

properties.name: DurationDisposalLevel
properties.definition: Duration interval at which disposal is performed

propertySets.name: Pset_MaintenanceTriggerPerformance
propertySets.definition: Properties for performance based maintenance policies

properties.name: TargetPerformance
properties.definition: Target capacity or performance of the asset. Units of the performance value are specified through the propertyValue units attribute.

properties.name: PerformanceMaintenanceLevel
properties.definition: Performance level at which maintenance takes place

properties.name: ReplacementLevel
properties.definition: Performance level at which replacement takes place

properties.name: DisposalLevel
properties.definition: Performance level at which disposal takes place

propertySets.name: Pset_ManufacturerOccurrence
propertySets.definition:
Defines properties of individual instances of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer.
HISTORY: IFC 2x4: AssemblyPlace property added. This property does not need to be asserted if Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation is allocated to the type and the AssemblyPlace property is asserted there.

properties.name: AcquisitionDate
properties.definition: The date that the manufactured item was purchased.

properties.name: BarCode
properties.definition: The identity of the bar code given to an occurrence of the product.

properties.name: SerialNumber
properties.definition: The manufacturer's serial number assigned to an occurrence of a product.

properties.name: BatchReference
properties.definition: The identity of the batch reference from which an occurrence of a product is taken.

properties.name: AssemblyPlace
properties.definition: Enumeration defining where the assembly is intended to take place, either in a factory, other offsite location or on the building site.

properties.name: ManufacturingDate
properties.definition: Date on which the element was manufactured.

propertySets.name: Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation
propertySets.definition:
Defines characteristics of types (ranges) of manufactured products that may be given by the manufacturer. Note that the term 'manufactured' may also be used to refer to products that are supplied and identified by the supplier or that are assembled off site by a third party provider.
HISTORY: This property set replaces the entity IfcManufacturerInformation from previous IFC releases. IFC 2x4: AssemblyPlace property added.

properties.name: GlobalTradeItemNumber
properties.definition: The Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) is an identifier for trade items developed by GS1 (www.gs1.org).

properties.name: ArticleNumber
properties.definition: Article number or reference that is be applied to a configured product according to a standard scheme for article number definition as defined by the manufacturer. It is often used as the purchasing number.

properties.name: ModelReference
properties.definition: The model number or designator of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: ModelLabel
properties.definition: The descriptive model name of the product model (or product line) as assigned by the manufacturer of the manufactured item.

properties.name: Manufacturer
properties.definition: The organization that manufactured and/or assembled the item.

properties.name: ProductionYear
properties.definition: The year of production of the manufactured item.

properties.name: AssemblyPlace
properties.definition: Enumeration defining where the assembly is intended to take place, either in a factory, other offsite location or on the building site.

properties.name: OperationalDocument
properties.definition: Manufacturer's operational document

properties.name: SafetyDocument
properties.definition: Manufacturer's safety document

properties.name: PerformanceCertificate
properties.definition: Manufacturer's performance certificate

propertySets.name: Pset_RepairOccurrence
propertySets.definition: Properties defining repair information for occurrences of element, asset or system.

properties.name: RepairContent
properties.definition: Content of repair, reason and nature can be given, e.g. display faults, communication failure, display exchange.

properties.name: RepairDate
properties.definition: Date on which the last repair is done on the asset.

properties.name: MeanTimeToRepair
properties.definition: Mean time to repair.

propertySets.name: Pset_ServiceLife
propertySets.definition: Captures the period of time that an artifact will last.  HISTORY: Introduced in IFC2X4 as replacement for IfcServiceLife.

properties.name: ServiceLifeDuration
properties.definition: The length or duration of a service life.The lower bound indicates pessimistic service life, the upper bound indicates optimistic service life, and the setpoint indicates the typical service life.

properties.name: MeanTimeBetweenFailure
properties.definition: The average time duration between instances of failure of a product.

propertySets.name: Pset_Warranty
propertySets.definition: An assurance given by the seller or provider of an artefact that the artefact is without defects and will operate as described for a defined period of time without failure and that if a defect does arise during that time, that it will be corrected by the seller or provider.

properties.name: WarrantyIdentifier
properties.definition: The identifier assigned to a warranty.

properties.name: WarrantyStartDate
properties.definition: The date on which the warranty commences.

properties.name: IsExtendedWarranty
properties.definition: Indication of whether this is an extended warranty whose duration is greater than that normally assigned to an artefact (=TRUE) or not (= FALSE).

properties.name: WarrantyPeriod
properties.definition: The time duration during which a manufacturer or supplier guarantees or warrants the performance of an artefact.

properties.name: WarrantyContent
properties.definition: The content of the warranty.

properties.name: PointOfContact
properties.definition: The organization that should be contacted for action under the terms of the warranty. Note that the role of the organization (manufacturer, supplier, installer etc.) is determined by the IfcActorRole attribute of IfcOrganization.

properties.name: Exclusions
properties.definition: Items, conditions or actions that may be excluded from the warranty or that may cause the warranty to become void.
